newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport jumps 51 pct on debut.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport jumps 51 pct on debut.

text.p: GZI Transport Ltd received an enthusiastic welcome from investors on Thursday who sent its shares surging 50.93 percent to close at HK$4.875 on their first day of trading.
Shares in the infrastructure spinoff of Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd moved in a range of HK$4.50 to HK$5.20 on volume of 121.30 million shares.
"It performed satisfactorily and was more or less in line with expectations in view of its grey market price," said Michael Ng, analyst at ASG Investment.
GZI Transport issued 250 million new shares at HK$3.23 per share. The 31.25 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong was 529 times subscribed.

Global co-ordinator Peregrine Capital Ltd had exercised an overallotment option and 37.5 million additional shares were issued -- 22.5 million for international investors and 15 million for the Hong Kong public.
Analysts said hopes of future asset injections by GZI Transport's parent and the potential for strong earnings growth should bring support to the share price over the long term.
"As most of its roads are in the high (economic) growth Guangdong province where there is a heavy traffic flow, we think it had quality roads and its earnings potential seems bright," said Ng.
But brokers said profit-taking could set in around the stock's grey market price of over HK$5.00.

"People were a bit overbullish and a strong flotation response boosted the grey market price a bit too high," said one research manager at a local brokerage. He said the company's "quality assets" were fairly valued at the current price level.

GZI Transport has invested in six toll road projects, with a total length of 224 kilometres. It said proceeds of the offering would be used to finance its investments in existing and future toll road projects in China.
